name: browser-agent-mcp-farm

tools.name: farm_acquire_context
tools.description: Acquire an isolated browser lease (BrowserContext) with capability, allowed-domain, and page-limit guards. Call FIRST before opening pages. Use read-only (default) for capture; read-write only to click/fill/press.

agentId.description: ID of the calling agent; recorded as the lease owner and required by every later tool call.

runId.description: Caller-chosen run identifier used to group artifacts for one research run.

artifactRunDir.description: Absolute directory where this run's artifacts (screenshots, text, ledgers) are written.

ttlMs.description: Lease time-to-live in ms (max 1h). Extend with farm_heartbeat during long work.

allowedDomains.description: Allowlist of hostnames this lease may open; requests to other domains are refused.

maxPages.description: Maximum concurrent open pages for this lease (max 20).

capability.description: 'read-only' for capture (default); 'read-write' only when you must click/fill/press. Payment/booking actions are always refused.

storagePolicy.description: 'ephemeral' (fresh context, default); 'storage-state' (reuse a saved cookie jar); 'persistent-profile' (a real on-disk browser profile).

profileName.description: Named saved profile to reuse (with storage-state/persistent-profile). One active lease per profile, enforced across processes.

storageStatePath.description: Explicit path to a Playwright storageState JSON (alternative to profileName).

userDataDir.description: Explicit persistent user-data directory (used with persistent-profile).

proxy.description: Optional upstream proxy for this context.

tools.name: farm_heartbeat
tools.description: Extend a lease's TTL so it is not reaped during long multi-step work. Call periodically.

agentId.description: ID of the calling agent; must own the lease.

tools.name: farm_open_page
tools.description: Open a URL in a leased context and return a pageId. Requires an active lease from farm_acquire_context.

agentId.description: ID of the calling agent; must own the lease.

url.description: URL to open in the leased context.

tools.name: farm_capture
tools.description: Capture browser-visible evidence (screenshot, text, HTML, metadata, visible links, media index) of the current page into the run's artifact ledger. Read-only.

agentId.description: ID of the calling agent; must own the lease.

tools.name: farm_wait
tools.description: Wait a fixed number of milliseconds on a page to let content settle. Prefer farm_wait_for_selector when you know the target element.

agentId.description: ID of the calling agent; must own the lease.

tools.name: farm_wait_for_selector
tools.description: Wait until a CSS selector is present/visible (bounded by timeout). Use before capturing or acting on dynamic content.

agentId.description: ID of the calling agent; must own the lease.

tools.name: farm_scroll
tools.description: Scroll a page down/up/top/bottom to reveal lazy-loaded content before capture.

agentId.description: ID of the calling agent; must own the lease.

tools.name: farm_capture_after_idle
tools.description: Wait for network/DOM idle (bounded), then capture. Use for SPA/dynamic pages where content arrives after load.

agentId.description: ID of the calling agent; must own the lease.

tools.name: farm_sample_frames
tools.description: Sample timestamped frame screenshots from visible media (required to support visual claims). Supports dense sampling around transcript/OCR/scene-change hits.

agentId.description: ID of the calling agent; must own the lease.

tools.name: farm_evidence_run
tools.description: Flagship one-shot research workflow: given a URL it captures the page, derives evidence (frames/OCR/transcript/official-API/obstructions), runs source strategy, and produces a final claim-gated report. Prefer this for end-to-end research; it manages its own lease. Returns runDir + reportPath; the result is isError when the final claim gate fails.

url.description: The page to research. The farm captures the rendered page, derives evidence (frames/OCR/transcript/official-API/obstructions), runs source strategy, and produces a claim-gated report.

runDir.description: Directory for this run's artifacts. Defaults to a temp directory; the chosen path is returned as `runDir`.

sampleFrames.description: Sample timestamped frames from visible media (required to support visual claims). Default true.

finalClaimGate.description: Run the final claim gate; the report (and the MCP result) fails if any claim is uncited or there are zero claims. Default true.

profileName.description: Named saved profile to drive this run (for authenticated or anti-bot-sensitive pages).

headed.description: Run with a visible browser window. NOT supported over MCP (use the CLI); MCP evidence-run is headless.

researchIntent.description: Soft intent lock. The farm records decision scope, required evidence shapes, recommended modalities, missing questions, and boundaries without blocking capture.

decisionNeeded.description: What decision this run supports: alpha pick, trend watch, price compare, UI/design teardown, user-pain mining, source verification, etc.

targetScope.description: Entity/product/person/place, geography/language, time horizon, and must-include or must-exclude sources.

evidenceShapes.description: Modalities that matter for this run: text/html, structured data, UI screenshot, OCR, video frames, captions, STT/ASR, TTS/audio, map/place state, or BYO bytes.

successCriteria.description: What would count as useful, surprising, or decision-changing.

boundaries.description: Login/profile/BYO permissions and refusal lines such as no paywall/CAPTCHA/raw-media bypass.

httpFetch.description: Tier-0 browserless capture: try a plain HTTP GET first (no Chromium) when the page is server-rendered; falls back to the browser if it declines. No screenshots/frames are produced on the tier-0 path. Default false.

captureRouting.description: Capture routing. 'auto' tries the tier-0 browserless HTTP GET first and escalates to the browser whenever the page is a client-rendered shell, non-HTML, off-domain, or bot-blocked — so it is never a worse capture than 'browser', but a server-rendered page is captured without launching Chromium (and is labelled http_fetch, with no screenshot). 'browser' (default) always uses Chromium, leaving the default capture method, screenshot, and provenance unchanged.

captureCache.description: Opt-in capture replay (C4). When a bare ephemeral run on the bundled Chromium engine would re-capture bytes identical to a recent run under the same run-root, replay that prior capture (same SHA-256) instead of launching the browser. Conservative for a verification tool: freshness is clamped to <= 1h, the replayed page claim is labelled 'cached_capture' with its staleness age (never 'browser_visible'), and a credentialed/fingerprinted/branded-channel run is never cached. Default false.

captureProfile.description: Browser capture profile. 'text' blocks image/media/font + ad-host subrequests and skips the page screenshot (faster text/structure-only runs); 'full' (default) captures everything including the screenshot.

tools.name: farm_read_report
tools.description: Read back the Markdown report a prior farm_evidence_run produced, given its reportPath. Read-only; no browser.

reportPath.description: Path to a final report file, exactly as returned by farm_evidence_run's `reportPath`.

tools.name: farm_list_artifacts
tools.description: List the artifact ledger (artifacts.jsonl) for a prior run's runDir, optionally filtered by evidence kind. Read-only; no browser.

runDir.description: Run directory (the `runDir` returned by farm_evidence_run) whose artifacts.jsonl ledger to list.

evidenceKind.description: Optional filter: only return artifacts of this evidence kind (e.g. frame_screenshot, destination_triage).

limit.description: Maximum number of artifact rows to return.

tools.name: farm_run_claim_gate
tools.description: Re-run the claim gate over an existing run's runDir to validate that claims cite registered, hash-verified artifacts. Read-only; the result is isError when the gate fails.

runDir.description: Run directory (the `runDir` returned by farm_evidence_run) to validate.

mode.description: 'final' enforces typed claims, citation provenance, and at least one cited claim; 'smoke' is lenient.

minClaims.description: Minimum number of claims required (defaults to 1 in final mode, 0 in smoke mode).

strictProvenance.description: When true, a claim citing AGENT-AUTHORED structured_data (self-asserted JSON, not farm-derived) is a hard error instead of a warning — closes the measured 'structured-in-disguise' repackaging hole for audits that demand witnessed provenance.

tools.name: farm_read_artifact
tools.description: Read one registered artifact's bytes (text or base64) by artifactId or path, RE-HASHING on read to detect tampering (recordedSha256 vs recomputed). Lets a parallel agent SEE another run's evidence and verify it. Read-only; isError if not found or tampered.

runDir.description: Run directory (the `runDir` from farm_evidence_run) containing the artifact ledger.

artifactId.description: artifact_id to read (from farm_list_artifacts). Provide this OR `path`.

path.description: The artifact's ledger `path` relative to runDir. Provide this OR `artifactId`.

maxBytes.description: Maximum bytes to return; content is truncated past this.

asText.description: Force text (utf8) vs binary (base64). Default: text for text-like evidence kinds, base64 for screenshots/media.

tools.name: farm_register_evidence
tools.description: Register a piece of evidence (the exact bytes/text you saw) as a hash-verified artifact you can then cite, returning its artifactId. The first half of authoring a cite-or-fail claim.

runDir.description: Run directory to register the artifact into (a fresh dir for a new bundle, or an existing runDir).

text.description: The UTF-8 evidence content to register (e.g. the exact text you will cite). Provide this OR bytesBase64.

bytesBase64.description: Exact BYO evidence bytes encoded as base64. Provide this OR text when preserving non-text/browser-external bytes.

mime.description: MIME type for bytesBase64 evidence, e.g. image/png or application/octet-stream.

format.description: File extension/format for bytesBase64 evidence, e.g. png, har, html, bin.

evidenceKind.description: Typed kind of this evidence (default page_text).

sourceUrl.description: The source the evidence came from (recorded as provenance).

captureId.description: Optional id for the artifact filename.

captureMethod.description: How these bytes were captured, e.g. 'byo-firecrawl' / 'byo-operator' / 'byo-human' / 'byo-mobile-har' (default 'agent-authored').

capturedBy.description: Id of the tool/agent/human that captured these bytes (provenance).

capturedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the bytes were captured (defaults to now).

tools.name: farm_register_transcript
tools.description: Register a video's transcript (its caption/spoken track) from any LAWFUL source — a served WebVTT track captured on the wire, a transcript tool, or a human paste — as a transcript_cue artifact you can cite. Supply WebVTT (parsed into timed cues) or plain text. The farm performs NO speech-to-text; the transcript is the platform's own caption, recorded with bring-your-own-capture provenance. The second half of a cite-or-fail spoken-content claim.

runDir.description: Run directory to register the transcript artifact into (a fresh dir, or an existing runDir).

sourceUrl.description: The video/source URL the transcript came from (recorded as provenance).

vtt.description: WebVTT caption text; parsed into timed cues. Provide this OR text.

text.description: Plain-text transcript; registered as-is. Provide this OR vtt.

captureMethod.description: How the transcript was captured, e.g. 'byo-transcript' / 'farm-vtt' / 'byo-human' (default 'byo-transcript').

capturedBy.description: Id of the tool/agent/human that captured the transcript (provenance).

tools.name: farm_add_claim
tools.description: Author a substantive claim that cites a registered artifact, with an optional anchor (where in the artifact it is grounded). The gate runs immediately: a claim whose anchor text is NOT in the cited bytes makes the result isError. This is how an agent's OWN answer becomes cite-or-fail, not just runner boilerplate.

runDir.description: Run directory containing the cited artifact's ledger.

claim.description: The substantive claim text you are asserting.

artifactId.description: artifact_id of the registered evidence this claim cites (from farm_register_evidence / farm_list_artifacts).

anchor.description: WHERE in the cited artifact the claim is grounded; verified against the bytes.

quote.description: Exact text the claim is grounded on; must appear in the cited text/HTML/OCR artifact.

normalizedTokens.description: Optional normalized supporting tokens for derived/aggregated claims.

verificationLevel.description: Verification level recorded on the claim.

timestampSec.description: Required for visual claims citing a frame screenshot.

corroboration.description: Cross-source corroboration: assert this claim is backed by multiple INDEPENDENT sources. The gate verifies each cited source is registered, verifies any per-source quote against that source's bytes, and counts distinct registrable domains — it proves N independent hash-verified sources are cited, not that they semantically agree.

artifactId.description: artifact_id of an INDEPENDENT supporting source (already registered).

quote.description: Optional supporting text that the gate verifies appears in THIS source's bytes.

sources.description: Additional independent sources that support this claim, beyond the primary artifactId.

minIndependentSources.description: Minimum distinct registrable-domain sources required across the primary + supporting sources; the gate fails the claim below this. Default 2.

tools.name: farm_judge_claim
tools.description: Submit a SEMANTIC verdict (supported | refuted | insufficient) over a claim, citing the SUPPORTING and/or REFUTING spans you rely on. The gate verifies every cited span literally appears in its source's bytes and enforces a quorum: a 'supported' verdict needs >= minIndependentSources verified supporting spans from distinct registrable domains and no verified refuting span. Your verdict is untrusted, but it cannot stand on a fabricated/recombined span. Use for cross-source synthesis where token-presence grounding is too weak. isError if a span does not verify or the verdict is structurally inconsistent.

runDir.description: Run directory holding the cited sources' ledger.

verdict.description: The judge's verdict over the cited spans.

support.description: Spans that SUPPORT the claim; each verified against its source's bytes.

quote.description: Contiguous text the gate verifies appears verbatim in THIS source's bytes.

refute.description: Spans that REFUTE/contradict the claim; each verified against its source's bytes.

quote.description: Contiguous text the gate verifies appears verbatim in THIS source's bytes.

minIndependentSources.description: Independent registrable-domain sources required among the verified SUPPORT spans for a 'supported' verdict. Default 2.

tools.name: farm_close_page
tools.description: Close a page in a leased context when finished with it.

agentId.description: ID of the calling agent; must own the lease.

tools.name: farm_click
tools.description: Guarded click on a selector. Requires a read-write lease; payment/booking/account-changing controls are refused.

agentId.description: ID of the calling agent; must own the lease.

selector.description: CSS selector for the target element.

tools.name: farm_fill
tools.description: Guarded fill of a form field. Requires a read-write lease.

agentId.description: ID of the calling agent; must own the lease.

selector.description: CSS selector for the target element.

value.description: Text to fill into the field.

tools.name: farm_press
tools.description: Guarded key press on a page (e.g. Enter to submit a search). Requires a read-write lease.

agentId.description: ID of the calling agent; must own the lease.

tools.name: farm_select_option
tools.description: Guarded <select> option choice. Requires a read-write lease.

agentId.description: ID of the calling agent; must own the lease.

tools.name: farm_release_context
tools.description: Release a lease and close its browser context. Call when finished to free the profile lock and resources.

agentId.description: ID of the calling agent; must own the lease.

tools.name: farm_list_leases
tools.description: List active leases (agent, capability, domains, page count, TTL). Read-only diagnostics.

tools.name: farm_reap_expired
tools.description: Reap expired leases and close their contexts. Maintenance/cleanup.

tools.name: farm_capabilities
tools.description: Identify THIS server (name, version, evidence kinds, non-goals, optional deps, lenses). Call to confirm you reached browser-agent-mcp-farm and not a similarly-named browse skill.

tools.name: farm_lens
tools.description: List the declarative research lenses, or describe one (lensId: research | market_scan | product_planning) with its claim templates, report sections, and prioritized source-registry entries. A lens is a domain config (e.g. marketing, product planning) over the same capture + cite-or-fail engine. Read-only, no browser.

lensId.description: Lens id to describe with its claim templates, report sections, and prioritized sources (research | market_scan | product_planning). Omit to list all lenses.

locale.description: Optional locale segment (e.g. ko-KR, en-US, global) to narrow the lens's prioritized source-registry entries.

tools.name: farm_list_runs
tools.description: List prior evidence-run directories under a root (default: the temp dir) with artifact/claim counts, so you can find a runDir to read or verify. Read-only.

runRoot.description: Directory to scan for run folders. Defaults to the system temp dir, where evidence-run writes.

limit.description: Maximum number of runs to return.

tools.name: farm_extract_structured
tools.description: Deterministically parse captured HTML for structured data (JSON-LD, Open Graph, Twitter cards, canonical, title). Byte-reproducible, no network. Publisher markup is a SITE CLAIM, not ground truth — cross-check against DOM/OCR. Pair with farm_read_artifact on a page_html artifact.

html.description: Captured HTML to parse. Provide this, OR runDir + artifactId/path to load a page_html artifact.

runDir.description: Run directory holding the HTML artifact (alternative to passing html).

artifactId.description: artifact_id of a page_html artifact in runDir to parse.

path.description: Ledger path of the HTML artifact (alternative to artifactId).

tools.name: farm_export_bundle
tools.description: Export a verifiable bundle manifest for a run: a Merkle root over its artifact SHA-256 hashes, plus an optional Ed25519 signature (privateKeyEnv). A second agent can re-verify it with farm_verify_bundle without trusting you.

runDir.description: Run directory to export a verifiable bundle manifest for.

privateKeyEnv.description: Name of an env var holding an Ed25519 private key (PEM) to sign the Merkle root. Omit to skip signing.

tools.name: farm_verify_bundle
tools.description: Re-verify a bundle manifest against a run's artifacts IN PLACE: re-hashes each file (detects tampered bytes), recomputes the Merkle root (detects a tampered manifest), and optionally checks the signature. No network. isError if anything fails.

runDir.description: Run directory whose artifacts the manifest is checked against (re-hashed in place).

publicKeyEnv.description: Name of an env var holding the Ed25519 public key (PEM) to verify the signature. Omit to skip signature verification.
